summary: Added apply_chart_edits_owned and OwnedPatchError, using the shared planner and a safe two-pass in-place splice algorithm. Added six integration tests; all 165 existing unit tests and six integration tests pass.

design_decisions: The owned API takes sole ownership of the input Vec. Planning and validation borrow it without mutation; failures move the same vector into OwnedPatchError. The error owns its PatchError, implements Debug/Display/Error, and exposes the typed underlying error through Error::source.

Validation checks planned ranges, overlaps and checked final size before writing. First compact retained original bytes, then expand backward with owned planned fragments. This avoids a second full input/output buffer and preserves pointer and capacity whenever final length fits, regardless of temporary expansion implied by edit order.
Both APIs share the existing planner and splice validation. Existing public signatures, variants and public fields remain unchanged; PatchError gains the Error trait to support typed source chaining.

Hardened planner accesses for empty public ChartData, invalid clone template ranges, invalid numbering ranges and malformed constituent deletion spans. Removed debug-only assumptions about template numbering span lengths; rescanned fragment spans determine clone edits.

Integration tests compare every supported operation against the borrowed API, exercise equal-anchor multiple series insertions, exact-capacity mixed replacement lengths, structural growth and shrinkage, recoverable validation failures, and error lifetimes after borrowed inputs disappear.
limitations: This is isolated crate validation, not a full document engine or visual integration test.
Allocator exhaustion follows ordinary Vec allocation behavior; recovery is guaranteed for validation errors, not process-level allocation failure.
No external sources, other packets, parent repositories, or prior evaluation results were read. No benchmarks or model-performance metrics were produced.
